rules: Every parent transaction must hash to the referenced input txid.
Every token-bearing input must carry complete parent transaction context.
The unsigned transaction token prefixes and PSBT output token fields must agree.
Genesis category IDs must be derived from actual vout=0 outpoints, not labels.
A valid consensus transaction must pass independent BCH and CashToken validation.
A SeedCash emulator result is not physical-hardware evidence.
A SeedCash parse or signature result is not proof of consensus validity.

scenarios.title: P2PKH 1 to 1
scenarios.description: Simple transfer of pure BCH from 1 P2PKH input to 1 P2PKH output (no change).

scenarios.title: P2PKH 1 to 2
scenarios.description: Standard transaction with a payment to a third party and the remaining balance returned to the sender’s change address.

scenarios.title: BCH Consolidation (N to 1)
scenarios.description: Spend multiple small BCH UTXOs and consolidate them into a single P2PKH output.

scenarios.title: BCH Distribution (1 to N)
scenarios.description: Payroll or batch distribution of BCH from 1 UTXO to dozens of independent P2PKH outputs.

scenarios.title: Standard P2SH Spend
scenarios.description: Spend a classic 20-byte P2SH UTXO (e.g. traditional multisignature).

scenarios.title: P2SH-32 Spend
scenarios.description: Spend a 32-byte P2SH UTXO (introduced in BCH to avoid hash collisions and enable advanced contracts).

scenarios.title: Pure OP_RETURN (Data)
scenarios.description: BCH transaction with 1 input and one OP_RETURN output containing up to 220 bytes of metadata/pushdata.

scenarios.title: Relative Timelock (CSV)
scenarios.description: Spend a P2SH UTXO protected by OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY, requiring a minimum number of blocks to have elapsed.

scenarios.title: Absolute Timelock (CLTV)
scenarios.description: Spend using OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY conditioned on a specific Unix time or block height.

scenarios.title: Pure FT Genesis (Input 0)
scenarios.description: Input 0 spends a UTXO with vout = 0. The output issues N Fungible Tokens (FTs). The category ID is the txid spent at vout = 0.

scenarios.title: FT Genesis in Secondary Input
scenarios.description: Genesis where the input whose outpoint.vout = 0 is not at input index 0 (e.g. Input 2 has vout = 0).

scenarios.title: Immutable NFT Genesis (none)
scenarios.description: Issue 1 NFT with none capability and no commitment (0 bytes of data).

scenarios.title: Immutable NFT Genesis with Commitment
scenarios.description: Issue 1 NFT with none capability and a binary data commitment (up to 40 bytes).

scenarios.title: Mutable NFT Genesis (mutable)
scenarios.description: Issue 1 NFT with mutable capability and an initial commitment.

scenarios.title: Minting NFT Genesis (minting)
scenarios.description: Issue 1 NFT with minting capability, allowing future tokens of that category to be minted.

scenarios.title: Mixed Genesis: FT + Immutable NFT
scenarios.description: Genesis in a single output containing both N FTs and 1 none-capability NFT of the new category.

scenarios.title: Mixed Genesis: FT + Mutable NFT
scenarios.description: Issue, in 1 output, N FTs and 1 NFT with mutable capability.

scenarios.title: Mixed Genesis: FT + Minting NFT
scenarios.description: Issue, in 1 output, N FTs and minting capability for the new category.

scenarios.title: Double Genesis in One PSBT
scenarios.description: Two independent inputs, both with vout = 0 from different previous transactions, issuing two different Token Category IDs in the same PSBT.

scenarios.title: Exact FT Transfer 1:1
scenarios.description: 1 input with N FTs of Category A -> 1 output with N FTs of Category A (no token change).

scenarios.title: FT Transfer with Change
scenarios.description: 1 input with 100 FTs -> Output 0: 30 FTs (payment); Output 1: 70 FTs (change).

scenarios.title: FT Consolidation
scenarios.description: M inputs containing Category A FTs -> 1 output summing the exact total of FTs.

scenarios.title: FT Splitting
scenarios.description: 1 input with 1000 FTs -> 10 independent outputs of 100 FTs each.

scenarios.title: Multi-Category Transfer (2 FTs)
scenarios.description: Inputs with Category A and Category B FTs -> outputs independently preserving the amounts of A and B.

scenarios.title: Multi-Category Transfer with Change
scenarios.description: Inputs A and B -> Payment A output, Change A output, Payment B output, Change B output.

scenarios.title: FT Transfer Across 5+ Categories
scenarios.description: A single PSBT simultaneously moving 5 or more distinct Category IDs among multiple participants.

scenarios.title: BCH and FT Change in the Same Output
scenarios.description: The change output contains both the remaining FTs and the remaining BCH not used for fees.

scenarios.title: BCH Change Separate from FT Change
scenarios.description: Output 1 receives FT change with dust-limit satoshis; Output 2 receives pure BCH change in P2PKH.

scenarios.title: Immutable NFT Transfer (none)
scenarios.description: Move a none-capability NFT from input to output. The commitment must not change.

scenarios.title: Commitment Update (Mutable NFT)
scenarios.description: Input with a mutable NFT and commitment D1 -> output with a mutable NFT and modified commitment D2.

scenarios.title: Downgrade Mutable NFT to Immutable
scenarios.description: Input with mutable NFT -> output with none capability (fixes the state and destroys mutation capability).

scenarios.title: Simple Mint of 1 NFT (Minting)
scenarios.description: Input with minting NFT -> Output 0 retains minting capability; Output 1 creates a new none-capability NFT.

scenarios.title: Multiple NFT Minting
scenarios.description: Input with minting NFT -> Output 0 retains minting; Outputs 1..N create N new NFTs with different commitments.

scenarios.title: Mint Mutable NFT
scenarios.description: Minting input creates a new NFT with mutable capability assigned to a third party.

scenarios.title: Minting Capability Splitting
scenarios.description: Input with 1 minting NFT -> Outputs 0 and 1 both have minting capability (the issuance capability is multiplied).
notes: Negative case: one input minting NFT cannot be duplicated into two minting authorities. The validator must reject this transaction.

scenarios.title: Mint FTs from Minting NFT
scenarios.description: Input with a minting NFT of Category A (no FTs) -> outputs creating 1,000,000 new FTs of Category A.

scenarios.title: Combined FT + NFT Minting
scenarios.description: Minting input -> output simultaneously issues new FTs and new NFTs of the same category.

scenarios.title: Transfer of Multiple Distinct NFTs
scenarios.description: PSBT spending 3 NFTs from 3 completely different categories in one atomic transaction.

scenarios.title: Hybrid NFT + FT + BCH Output
scenarios.description: A single output stores 500 FTs, 1 mutable NFT, and the satoshis reserved for the UTXO.

scenarios.title: Commitment Swap Between NFTs
scenarios.description: Transaction processing 2 mutable NFTs from the same category and swapping their commitment payloads.

scenarios.title: Partial FT Burn (50% Example)
scenarios.description: Inputs total 1000 FTs of Category A. Outputs assign only 500 FTs. The remaining 50% is implicitly burned.

scenarios.title: Minimum Partial Burn (1 FT)
scenarios.description: Inputs total N FTs; outputs assign N-1 FTs.

scenarios.title: Total FT Burn (100% Burn)
scenarios.description: Spend a UTXO containing FTs to a pure BCH output without specifying the category in the outputs.

scenarios.title: Immutable NFT Burn (none)
scenarios.description: Input contains a none-capability NFT that is included in no output, destroying it.

scenarios.title: Mutable NFT Burn (mutable)
scenarios.description: Spend the input with a mutable NFT and remove it from the outputs to freeze its state/existence.
notes: Burning the mutable NFT destroys it; it does not freeze or preserve the state. A freeze-like transition is a retained none-capability NFT.

scenarios.title: Destroy Minting Capability
scenarios.description: Burn the minting NFT, permanently closing the ability to mint more tokens of that category.

scenarios.title: Selective Multi-Category Burn
scenarios.description: Inputs with Category A and Category B: transfer the A tokens but burn the B tokens.

scenarios.title: Mixed Burn (NFT Burn + FT Preservation)
scenarios.description: Input with NFT + FTs of the same category: the NFT is destroyed and the FTs are preserved in the outputs.

scenarios.title: FT Burn with NFT Preservation
scenarios.description: Input with NFT + FTs: burn all FTs and only pass the NFT to the output.

scenarios.title: Mass Multi-Category Burn (Cleanup)
scenarios.description: A cleanup PSBT spending 10 UTXOs containing different junk/spam tokens without passing them to the outputs.

scenarios.title: UTXO vout = 0 Non-Genesis (Existing Token)
scenarios.description: Spend a UTXO with outpoint.vout = 0 that ALREADY contained an existing token (does not activate genesis; operates as a transfer).

scenarios.title: UTXO vout = 0 Non-Genesis (Pure BCH)
scenarios.description: Spend a pure BCH UTXO at vout = 0 in a transaction that does NOT generate new tokens.

scenarios.title: Mixed Genesis + Neutral vout = 0 UTXO
scenarios.description: Input 0 (vout=0 activates genesis of Category A) + Input 1 (vout=0 from another transaction transferred as pure BCH).

scenarios.title: OP_RETURN in Output 0 with Tokens in Output 1
scenarios.description: Output 0 contains an OP_RETURN script. Tokens must be mapped correctly to Output 1 onward.

scenarios.title: OP_RETURN Interleaved Between Tokens
scenarios.description: Output 0 (Token A), Output 1 (metadata OP_RETURN), Output 2 (Token B).

scenarios.title: Non-Contiguous Token Outputs
scenarios.description: CashToken outputs separated by pure BCH outputs without tokens.

scenarios.title: Consolidation of Mixed-vout UTXOs
scenarios.description: Inputs originating from vout = 0, vout = 1, and vout = 5, all spent in the same PSBT.

scenarios.title: P2SH Multisig (2 of 3) with NFT Mutation
scenarios.description: Two of three participants sign the PSBT to authorize changing the commitment of a jointly managed NFT.

scenarios.title: Asynchronous Multi-User Signing
scenarios.description: A PSBT travels between 3 different wallets that add partial signatures for complex token transfers.

scenarios.title: Token CoinJoin (Mixer)
scenarios.description: Collaborative PSBT with 5 participants who combine FT inputs and outputs to reduce traceability.

scenarios.title: PSBT with Complete UTXO Context
scenarios.description: PSBT format including complete previous-transaction data (non_witness_utxo / witness_utxo) to validate token amounts before signing.
notes: For SeedCash interoperability, compare non_witness_utxo and witness_utxo separately. Token-bearing inputs require a complete parent transaction.

scenarios.title: Exact Dust Limit (~546 Satoshis)
scenarios.description: CashToken output funded with the strict minimum dust-limit amount permitted by the network.

scenarios.title: BCH-Overfunded Token UTXO
scenarios.description: Token output carrying 1 BCH instead of dust (used to self-fund future fees).

scenarios.title: Maximum Commitment Size (40 Bytes)
scenarios.description: NFT whose commitment uses exactly the maximum 40 bytes of arbitrary binary data.

scenarios.title: Maximum FT Amount (2^63-1)
scenarios.description: Output assigning the maximum possible Fungible Token amount in the specification (9223372036854775807).

scenarios.title: Massive Consolidation (100 FT Inputs)
scenarios.description: Transaction consuming 100 UTXOs with FTs from the same category into a single output.

scenarios.title: Mass Distribution / Airdrop (100 FT Outputs)
scenarios.description: Transaction consuming 1 FT UTXO and distributing it among 100 different addresses in a single PSBT.

scenarios.title: Multi-Token Mesh Transaction
scenarios.description: 10 different FT categories and 5 NFTs with different capabilities interacting in a single PSBT.

scenarios.title: Mega-Exotic All-in-One Transaction
scenarios.description: Category A genesis + Category B minting NFT issuance + Category C FT transfer + BCH transfer in the same UTXO where Category C is sent + minting to the same address, with Category I NFT + Category I FT + BCH all in the same output + 50% burn of Category D + Category E NFT mutation + OP_RETURN all in one PSBT.

negativeScenarios.title: Invalid PSBT magic
negativeScenarios.description: Replace the psbt\xff magic prefix with arbitrary bytes.

negativeScenarios.title: Truncated PSBT map
negativeScenarios.description: Truncate the global, input, or output map at every byte boundary.

negativeScenarios.title: Missing unsigned transaction
negativeScenarios.description: Remove PSBT_GLOBAL_UNSIGNED_TX while leaving otherwise plausible maps.

negativeScenarios.title: Mismatched v145 input or output counts
negativeScenarios.description: Make the v145 global input/output counts disagree with the unsigned transaction.

negativeScenarios.title: Ambiguous duplicate input context
negativeScenarios.description: Include duplicate keys or both witness_utxo and non_witness_utxo for one input.

negativeScenarios.title: Missing input sighash
negativeScenarios.description: Omit PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE from one input.

negativeScenarios.title: Unsupported or non-FORKID sighash
negativeScenarios.description: Use a BCH sighash without FORKID or with an unsupported flag combination.

negativeScenarios.title: Mixed sighashes across inputs
negativeScenarios.description: Give different inputs different requested sighash types.

negativeScenarios.title: Missing BIP32 key origin
negativeScenarios.description: Remove PSBT_IN_BIP32_DERIVATION from an input that otherwise belongs to the signer.

negativeScenarios.title: Wrong signer fingerprint or derivation path
negativeScenarios.description: Use a valid-looking derivation record that does not identify the SeedCash wallet key.

negativeScenarios.title: Parent transaction hash mismatch
negativeScenarios.description: Provide a decodable non_witness_utxo whose hash is not the input txid.

negativeScenarios.title: Parent output index out of range
negativeScenarios.description: Reference an output index that does not exist in the supplied parent transaction.

negativeScenarios.title: Token input without complete parent transaction
negativeScenarios.description: Attempt to spend a token-bearing input using only compact witness_utxo context.

negativeScenarios.title: PSBT token state disagrees with parent
negativeScenarios.description: Declare a different category, amount, capability, or commitment than the spent parent output.

negativeScenarios.title: Malformed CashToken prefix
negativeScenarios.description: Use a missing category, reserved bit, unknown capability, empty token, or truncated prefix.

negativeScenarios.title: NFT commitment over 40 bytes
negativeScenarios.description: Use a 41-byte NFT commitment.

negativeScenarios.title: Fungible amount over the signed 64-bit limit
negativeScenarios.description: Assign more than 9223372036854775807 fungible tokens.

negativeScenarios.title: Fungible output total exceeds input total
negativeScenarios.description: Create more fungible tokens in outputs than are supplied by inputs or valid genesis/minting rules.

negativeScenarios.title: Duplicated minting authority
negativeScenarios.description: The single minting NFT input is recreated as two minting NFT outputs; this is the negative form of source scenario 37.

negativeScenarios.title: Unapproved implicit token burn
negativeScenarios.description: Omit an input token from the outputs without an explicit user-approved burn intent.

negativeScenarios.title: Returned PSBT changes the approved unsigned transaction
negativeScenarios.description: Alter an output, input, token prefix, fee, or locktime after approval and return the modified PSBT.

negativeScenarios.title: Returned PSBT has an invalid signature
negativeScenarios.description: Return a signature made by the wrong key, over the wrong amount, or with the wrong sighash byte.

negativeScenarios.title: Incomplete multisig return
negativeScenarios.description: Return fewer valid signatures than the approved multisig threshold.

negativeScenarios.title: Signer returns no signatures
negativeScenarios.description: SeedCash returns a parseable PSBT without adding any partial signature.

negativeScenarios.title: Network mismatch
negativeScenarios.description: Present a mainnet or incompatible-network proposal to the chipnet watch-only signing path.

negativeScenarios.title: Invalid UR transport payload
negativeScenarios.description: Use truncated, reordered-incomplete, tampered, or CBOR-wrapped payloads that do not recover a raw PSBT for SeedCash.
